# ShliachFlow

> ShliachFlow is the website and AI partner for Chabad shluchim and Jewish nonprofits. It builds custom websites, provides AI and technology consulting, and offers the DAAS CRM. It is run by Rabbi Yisroel Chaim Shuchat, a Chabad shliach in San Pedro, California.

Contact: WhatsApp (310) 935-5236 (https://wa.me/13109355236), info@shliachflow.com. Address: 1536 W 25th St #614, San Pedro, CA 90732.

## What ShliachFlow does
- Websites (flagship): new sites, refreshes, mini sites and camp sites for Chabad Houses. Custom-coded, or built on Squarespace, ChabadOne or ChabadSuite.
- AI and technology consulting: finding where AI and the right tools can save time in a Chabad House, then setting them up.
- DAAS CRM: a CRM built for Chabad Houses by a fellow shliach, offered and supported by ShliachFlow in partnership with its developer. Details at https://daascrm.app
- Coming soon: AI agents, and a website platform for shluchim.
- Also available (small): books and learning materials, AI-assisted and personally reviewed.
